name: Biochemical Pathways: Photosynthesis and Cellular Respiration
subject: Biology
description: Examines the regulation of biochemical pathways in photosynthesis and cellular respiration, including the structure, stages, inputs, outputs and factors affecting each process. Also covers biotechnological applications including CRISPR-Cas9 and biofuel production.
